title: WoW Telemetry Combat Event
description: WebSocket event emitted by the daemon. Raw fields preserve the CSV values as strings; nil values become null.

fields.description: Ordered CSV payload after the event name. Values remain strings regardless of their source type in the combat log.

decoded_fields.description: Known event fields decoded by the YAML specification. Fields not named by the spec remain losslessly available in fields.
